data.message: I opt in to 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. Each of the other 24: state your exact intended catch and any conditions. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose18 and others10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250−8k; next stock is500 (75%) or500−16k (25%). Even all18 leaves50, but recovery to500 isn't guaranteed. Mixed choices are welcome; other allocations need recalculation. Intentions aren't binding, and this isn't guaranteed best long-term. Who'll opt in?
